info.title: Ledgerline Stock Market API
info.description: Indian company financials, ownership, corporate actions, and market information for your applications. Coverage varies by dataset; unavailable datasets and query variants return HTTP 501. Historical market prices are not included.

tags.name: enterprise
tags.description: Batches of up to 25 symbols; unsupported streaming and all-market variants are explicit

x-data-conventions: Compatibility financial statement amounts: INR rupees; EPS: INR per share.
Compatibility profitability ratios: fractions; ownership: percentages.
Compatibility missing source fields: null. Source summaries may be rounded or delayed.
Legacy company-data/extract values retain amount/baseValue; crore means INR crores. Legacy blank cells may become zero and absent rows may be omitted.
Date filters apply to the requested source page; follow X-Next-Page for paginated datasets.
X-Request-ID correlates every API response with request logs.
